_about: Language-neutral combat fixtures for COMBAT_SPEC.md. Both the GDScript implementation (Tingen: CombatResolver/ReflexRules/TacticalBrain) and the TypeScript implementation (Yumina port, later) MUST pass every vector. Float assertions use tolerance 1e-6; strings/bools/array shapes are exact. When implementations diverge, these fixtures are the arbiter.
_generated: Every `expected` block is MACHINE-GENERATED by running the GDScript reference implementation (tingen/tests/dump_combat_vectors.gd) — never hand-computed. Regenerate after an intentional algorithm change with: godot --headless --path tingen -s tests/dump_combat_vectors.gd (then re-run both vector runners).
_fixtures_note: All ability/kit fixtures are EMBEDDED here (ids prefixed vx_) — the vectors never read data/abilities.json, so authored-data edits can never break them. `kit` fields that are strings are refs into the top-level `kits` map.

resolver_apply.name: plain damage lands on hp and poise, deterministic
normalization: a partial target state fills hp 100 / max_hp 100 / poise 0 / no i-frames
shield absorbs before hp; a depleted pool is pruned
a larger shield eats the whole hit and keeps its remaining pool
an EXPIRED shield absorbs nothing (and stays in the array — only tick_statuses prunes)
shields stop damage but NEVER poise
i-frames zero the WHOLE hit: no damage, statuses, poise, knockback, zones, or transform
i-frame window edge: the hit lands the exact instant the window closes (now == i_frame_until_ms)
knockback rides the normalized hit direction scaled by the authored pixels
knockback diagonal: an irrational normalization (1e-6 float tolerance canary)
a zero direction yields zero knockback
status effect with authored magnitude + duration overrides the named defaults
a bare named status takes the NAMED_STATUS_DEFAULTS (slow -> 0.5 / 1200ms)
an authored duration on a named status keeps the default magnitude (hook slow: 0.5 x 1500ms)
an unknown status name lands inert: magnitude 1.0, duration 0 (never active)
a dot status effect defaults tick_ms to 500 and carries tick bookkeeping
rounding canary: seconds->ms uses round() — an exact .5 rounds UP (0.0005s -> 1ms, never 0)
a buff effect is a frenzy-family status on the TARGET (self-casts pass self as target)
transform only REPORTS transform_to — no damage, no state change
zone effects are REPORTED in deltas.zones, never applied to the target here
hp floors at 0 (downed is the caller's threshold), damage_dealt reports the full post-shield hit

resolver_chain.name: poise accumulates across hits; crossing POISE_BREAK staggers and resets the pool
poise EXACTLY at the break threshold staggers (>=, not >)
an i-framed hit mid-chain contributes NOTHING to the poise pool

resolver_sequence.name: status stacking: same kind merges, the STRONGER magnitude wins, the window refreshes
different kinds coexist; a status is active on the half-open window [applied, applied+duration)
shields never sum: re-applying a shield keeps ONE pool at the stronger magnitude
dot ticks accumulate per tick_ms, never double-count, and land up to AND INCLUDING the expiry instant
re-applying a dot preserves tick bookkeeping — no free extra tick on refresh
tick_statuses prunes on the half-open window: gone at exactly applied+duration

resolver_ledger.name: ledger: unmarked is ready; mark sets ready_at = now + cooldown; ready the exact instant it elapses
interrupt burns the cooldown: the mark happens at CAST ACCEPT and there is no refund op — an interrupted cast stays spent
resolver_ledger._note: The executor marks the ledger the moment try_cast accepts (before the windup). A stagger/stun/downed interrupt during the windup never unmarks. PINNED as intended (spec §5).

reflex.name: a projectile telegraph AT ME matches the class-keyed dodge row
at_me discrimination: a telegraph aimed elsewhere never matches an at_me row
a row WITHOUT at_me matches telegraphs aimed anywhere
a wrong-class telegraph never matches an of-keyed row
an ability-keyed telegraph row matches by ability id
a row keyed on BOTH ability and class requires both to match
hp_below reads SELF STATE on a bare frame evaluation (empty event)
hp_below is STRICT: hp_frac exactly at the threshold does not fire
ally_downed fires on the event kind alone
band_entered fires when the fight crosses into ITS band
cooldown_ready for a different ability never matches
delay clamps: 149->150 (floor), 150 stays, 800 stays, 801->800 (ceiling), 5000->800, absent->250 default
max_fires: a row at its cap never fires again (caller-owned fired_counts, keyed by rule index)
max_fires: one fire below the cap still fires
one evaluation returns EVERY due row in rule order (telegraph + hp_below together)
an unknown trigger kind never matches (authoring drift stays inert)

tactical_bands.name: bands derive from kit DATA: melee = max strike range, near = max projectile range
an empty kit degrades to the engine defaults 48/160
a projectile-less kit derives near = 2x melee (above the default floor)
a strike-less kit keeps the melee default; the projectile sets near
a short projectile (inside the default melee band) falls back to the near default
non strike/projectile classes never shape the bands

tactical_choose.name: THE fixed scenario / aggressive: highest-damage strike + strafe on top
THE fixed scenario / cautious: prefers the projectile + backs out of melee toward its near band
THE fixed scenario / defensive: counters only — no recent hit, no cast, holds ground
THE fixed scenario / desperate: shortest cooldown + reckless close (pursue to 0)
defensive answers within the counter window (recent_hit true)
aggressive at 300px: the damaging gap-closer (movement beats projectile in its class_pref) + pursue to melee
cautious at 300px sits in its near band: projectile + strafe
a cooling preferred class falls through to the next ready one
cooldowns compare against now_ms: the same ledger AFTER the cooldown elapses frees the pick
cautious just above its retreat line does not retreat (0.4 > 1/3)
desperate at critical hp still closes (retreat_hp 0 = never)
a transform is NEVER a tactical pick, even as the only ready ability (plan §0: the reveal is never an engine rule)
an unknown style degrades to aggressive
deterministic tie-break: equal class/rank falls to ascending ability id
a pure-repositioning movement skill (no effects) is steering's job, never a tactical cast
a self-target ability is castable at ANY distance (range-gating is for aimed classes)
